name: pixel-office
description: A live pixel-art office showing what every agent in the session is doing

autoOpen.title: Open the office
autoOpen.description: When the office pane opens by itself

history.title: Keep a history of jobs
history.description: Keep a short record of each job (the start of your message, how long it took, how many helpers and tokens) on this computer, across sessions

notify.title: Remind me when an agent waits on me
notify.description: After an agent has waited 30 seconds for your answer or permission, say so once, with a toast and a notification

picture.title: Office picture
picture.description: single: one picture for everybody, drawn afresh each time the pane is drawn (the default); layered: the scenery, the cat and each agent as separate pictures stacked over each other. Layered is experimental: the app starts every picture over whenever it draws the pane, so it offers nothing over single

debug.title: Debug log
debug.description: on: write a log of renders, events and what the pane reports to pixel-office/debug/log.jsonl (no commands, file names or text are logged, only event kinds, agent ids and timings); off: nothing
